svg.title: RH850/F1K R7F7015873AFP - 176-pin LQFP pin diagram (top view)
svg.desc: Top view of the Renesas RH850/F1K R7F7015873AFP VIP MCU, 176-pin LQFP. Pin assignment from RH850/F1K Hardware Manual Rev. 1.10 (R01UH0562EJ0110) Figure 2.3 (p. 81) and Table 2.3 (pp. 89-93). Ground pins in red, UART-capable (RLIN3n TX/RX) pins in blue.
svg.text: RH850/F1K R7F7015873AFP — 176-pin LQFP · UART, JTAG and GND pins
Top view · VIP MCU of the A11 Radio · marking 15873 (TM52176 = trace code) · pin assignment from RH850/F1K HW manual Rev. 1.10, Fig. 2.3 (p. 81) and Table 2.3 (pp. 89–93)
G3KH core · 2 MB code flash · 192 KB RAM · 120 MHz
Pin 1 = dot, top-left; pins count counter-clockwise
Pin 52 · P1_9 / RLIN34TX — VIP console TX (owner-reported; 115200 8N1)
Pin 53 · P1_8 / RLIN34RX — matching RX function; enabled state unverified
UART TX — pin has an RLIN3n TX function
UART RX — pin has an RLIN3n RX function
Other pins — first (port / power) function only
Colour = the pin can carry that function, not that this board uses it. Supply pins (EVCC, AWOVCL, REGVCC,
ISOVCL, A0VREF, A1VREF) are not highlighted. RLIN2n are LIN-only and not marked.
Pin (port) · Table 2.3 pp. 89–93 · RLIN3 = Section 19, p. 830
Table 36.1 p. 2742 · Table 39.1 p. 2777 · pin assignment p. 90
The flash-programming UART (FPDR/FPDT) is not RLIN3: it sits on the JP0 debug pins.
JP0_0–JP0_2 carry JTAG, LPD and flash programming at once.
Debug interfaces: Nexus, LPD 1-wire, LPD 4-wire (§36.1.1, p. 2740). Trace only on parts
with an EVTO pin (p. 2741); the manual does not say if this part qualifies.
A 128-bit ID code can lock debugger flash access (§36.1.1 item 13, p. 2741); OTP and ID
Pin 52 (RLIN34TX) is the owner-reported VIP console TX, not a debug pin. The manual does
not say what is attached to it.
Each RLIN3n channel can appear on 2–3 pins; the manual lists capability, not which pin
Source: Renesas RH850/F1K Hardware Manual Rev. 1.10 (R01UH0562EJ0110, 2016-11-30) — Fig. 2.3 (p. 81) and Table 2.3 (pp. 89–93) for the pin diagram; page numbers are the printed "Page N of 2863".

Package, marking and part number: hardware/teardown.md § RH850/F1K Package & UART Pinout (corrected 2026-11-12). Packaging/order suffixes beyond R7F7015873AFP are not established from the board marking.
Pin 52 as VIP console TX (115200 8N1) is owner-reported; pin 53 RX enabled state is unverified.
